note: Answer key: the Jira changes the UC3 agent should propose (and, after approval, apply). Shape matches propose_changes(creates, updates, transitions). temp_id E1 is the Epic; stories reference it via epic. Story points match consistency_report.md.

creates.description: Enam milestone trip, checklist SOP per milestone, tiket bertim dan jam tenang 22:00–05:00 WIB. PRD: expected/prd_uc1-milestone-checklist.md

creates.summary: [BE] As Logisly, I want each trip to move through six milestones set by gps, app or manual so that follow-up starts at the right step
creates.description: Bagian dari PRD checklist follow-up driver per milestone (UC1).
acceptance: Enam milestone: assigned, to_pickup, at_pickup, in_transit, at_drop, unloaded
Pengubah milestone tercatat sebagai gps, app atau manual

creates.summary: [BE] As Allocation, I want system checklist items filled from trip data so that drivers are not asked what the system already knows
creates.description: Bagian dari PRD checklist follow-up driver per milestone (UC1).
acceptance: Item sumber system terisi saat milestone berubah
Item khusus Shopee dilewati untuk trip non-Shopee

creates.summary: [AI Agent] As Driver, I want my photos read as evidence so that I am not asked again for what I already sent
creates.description: Bagian dari PRD checklist follow-up driver per milestone (UC1).
acceptance: Foto unit, surat jalan dan POD dibaca; plat dan jam dicocokkan
Item yang sudah dijawab tidak ditanya ulang

creates.summary: [AI Agent] As Driver, I want one short message with at most two open items so that I am not flooded with questions
creates.description: Bagian dari PRD checklist follow-up driver per milestone (UC1).
acceptance: Pesan pembuka hanya memuat item photo/driver yang masih terbuka
Maksimal 2 item per pesan
Pertanyaan driver dijawab lebih dulu dari data trip
Tidak ada item terbuka: tidak ada pesan

creates.summary: [BE] As Allocation, I want every not-OK item to become a ticket to the right team so that nobody has to follow up manually
creates.description: Bagian dari PRD checklist follow-up driver per milestone (UC1).
acceptance: Tiket berlabel logisly-checklist dan team-<tim>
Prioritas tinggi
Tiket berisi item, bukti dan trip

creates.summary: [BE] As Driver, I want no message between 22:00 and 05:00 WIB so that I can rest
creates.description: Bagian dari PRD checklist follow-up driver per milestone (UC1).
acceptance: Perubahan milestone di jam tenang mencatat checklist tapi menahan pesan
Pesan terkirim setelah 05:00 WIB atau saat dipaksa operator

creates.summary: [BE] As CT, I want a summary note when a milestone checklist is complete so that I can see the result at a glance
creates.description: Bagian dari PRD checklist follow-up driver per milestone (UC1).
acceptance: Catatan ringkasan privat dibuat sekali per milestone

creates.summary: [Ops Console] As Allocation, I want to see each trip's milestone stepper and checklist so that I can check the status of every item
creates.description: Bagian dari PRD checklist follow-up driver per milestone (UC1).
acceptance: Stepper enam milestone
Tiap item menampilkan sumber (system/photo/driver) dan status

creates.summary: [Ops Console] As CT, I want to set the milestone manually and force-send the driver message so that I can work when GPS is not ready
creates.description: Bagian dari PRD checklist follow-up driver per milestone (UC1).
acceptance: Pilihan gps / app / manual
Tombol kirim paksa saat jam tenang

creates.summary: [BE] As Logisly, I want the milestone to change automatically from GPS geofence events so that nobody sets it by hand
creates.description: Bergantung ke LOG-3405 (In Progress). Sebelum itu, milestone diubah manual atau dari app.
acceptance: Milestone titik muat dan bongkar berubah dari event geofence
Berjalan setelah LOG-3405 selesai

creates.summary: [BE] As Allocation, I want the Shopee-only checklist items so that Shopee trips follow the full SOP
creates.description: Bagian dari PRD checklist follow-up driver per milestone (UC1).
acceptance: ID driver Shopee aktif
Status onsite dan bongkar terdaftar di aplikasi Shopee

acceptance_append: Tombol upload POD muncul setelah status bongkar selesai
Foto POD terkirim ke Platform dengan jam dan plat (dibaca agent untuk item 'pod')
